title: Wasteland Weekend

services.name: RV Rental & On-site Services
services.desc: As always, Wasteland World events does NOT charge any extra fees for cars, camping, or RVs for any attendees, performers, vendors, or volunteers. (We also have unlimited ins-and-outs.) The private land the events take place on do not have any kind of hookups for electricity, water, or sewage. There is no running or potable water on site, and there is no dumping of any kind. BUT, we do have some big new updates for 2026! For those of you interested in renting an RV for our event, we have an arrangement with El Monte RV. They have a lot of RVs available and are festival-friendly. You can inquire about availability and pricing by using the booking form below: They will deliver the RV to site
